name: add_tooltip
title: Add Tooltip
description: Add a hover tooltip annotation to a region in the hex editor. Tooltips are visible in the ImHex GUI when the user hovers over the annotated bytes, useful for marking decoded values or notes.

size.description: Size of the region in bytes

text.description: Tooltip text to display on hover

color.description: RGBA color of the tooltip. Defaults to white (0xFFFFFFFF).
